lore: The census sacks ride a looping chute down to the hold, a bin for each island. Hold Master Peregrine's rule: tip one bin at a time, and drop its sacks one by one into the bins further down. Whenever the sowing passes the hatch, a sack falls into the hold, and the rest come round the loop again. Empty every bin into the hold in as few tips as you can.

lines.stowed: Every sack in the hold, and on the par count of tips. Sweetly sown.
lines.slow: All stowed, but you tipped more bins than you needed. Watch where the last sack lands.
lines.loose: Sacks still riding the chute. Keep sowing until every bin is empty.
